sentences.text: Saint Peter -LRB- Syriac/Aramaic : ܫܸܡܥܘܿܢ ܟܹ݁ܐܦ݂ܵܐ , Shemayon Keppa , שמעון בר יונה , Πέτρος , according to the New Testament , was one of the Twelve Apostles of Jesus Christ , leaders of the early Christian Great Church .	Great Church	Great Church	Jesus Christ	Jesus	Syriac/Aramaic	Syriac language	New Testament	New Testament	Twelve Apostles	Twelve Apostles	early Christian	Early Christianity

Hippolytus of Rome , a 3rd-century theologian , gave him the title of `` Apostle of the Apostles '' .	Apostle	Apostle	Rome	Rome	Hippolytus of Rome	Hippolytus of Rome	3rd-century	3rd century	theologian	Theology	Apostle of the Apostles	Prince of the Apostles

According to Catholic teaching , Peter was ordained by Jesus in the `` Rock of My Church '' dialogue in Matthew .	Catholic	Catholic Church	Catholic teaching	Catholic theology	ordained	ordination	Rock of My Church	Primacy of Simon Peter

He is traditionally counted as the first Bishop of Romeor popeand also by Eastern Christian tradition as the first Patriarch of Antioch .	Patriarch	Patriarch	tradition	Sacred tradition	Eastern Christian	Eastern Christianity	Antioch	Church of Antioch	Eastern Christian tradition	Eastern Christianity	Patriarch of Antioch	List of Patriarchs of Antioch	Christian tradition	Apostolic Age

The ancient Christian churches all venerate Peter as a major saint and as the founder of the Church of Antioch and the Roman Church , but differ in their attitudes regarding the authority of his present-day successors .	Antioch	Church of Antioch	saint	saint	venerate	veneration	Church of Antioch	Church of Antioch	Roman Church	Diocese of Rome	differ in their attitudes	Primacy of the Bishop of Rome#Opposition to the doctrine

The New Testament indicates that Peter was the son of John -LRB- or Jonah or Jona -RRB- and was from the village of Bethsaida in the province of Galilee or Gaulanitis .	Bethsaida	Bethsaida	Gaulanitis	Gaulanitis	New Testament	New Testament	Galilee	Galilee
His brother Andrew was also an apostle .	Andrew	Andrew the Apostle	apostle	Apostle (Christian)

According to New Testament accounts , Peter was one of twelve apostles chosen by Jesus from his first disciples .	New Testament	New Testament	twelve apostles	twelve apostles	disciples	Disciple (Christianity)
Originally a fisherman , he played a leadership role and was with Jesus during events witnessed by only a few apostles , such as the Transfiguration .	Transfiguration	Transfiguration of Jesus

According to the gospels , Peter confessed Jesus as the Messiah , was part of Jesus 's inner circle , thrice denied Jesus and wept bitterly once he realised his deed , and preached on the day of Pentecost .	confessed Jesus as the Messiah	Confession of Peter	thrice denied Jesus	Denial of Peter	Pentecost	Pentecost
According to Christian tradition , Peter was crucified in Rome under Emperor Nero Augustus Caesar .	tradition	Sacred tradition	Rome	Rome	Christian tradition	Apostolic Age	Nero Augustus Caesar	Nero
It is traditionally held that he was crucified upside down at his own request , since he saw himself unworthy to be crucified in the same way as Jesus .
Tradition holds that he was crucified at the site of the Clementine Chapel .	Clementine Chapel	Clementine Chapel

His remains are said to be those contained in the underground Confessio of St. Peter 's Basilica , where Pope Paul VI announced in 1968 the excavated discovery of a first-century Roman cemetery .	Pope	Pope	Confessio	Saint Peter's tomb	Pope Paul VI	Pope Paul VI	cemetery	cemetery

Every 29 June since 1736 , a statue of Saint Peter in St. Peter 's Basilica is adorned with papal tiara , ring of the fisherman , and papal vestments , as part of the celebration of the Feast of Saints Peter and Paul .	papal vestments	Papal regalia and insignia	papal tiara	papal tiara	ring of the fisherman	ring of the fisherman	Feast of Saints Peter and Paul	Feast of Saints Peter and Paul

According to Catholic doctrine , the direct papal successor to Saint Peter is the incumbent pope , currently Pope .	Pope	Pope	pope	pope	Catholic	Catholic Church	doctrine	doctrine	papal successor	Apostolic succession

Two general epistles in the New Testament are ascribed to Peter , but modern scholars reject the Petrine authorship of both .	New Testament	New Testament	general epistles	general epistles	Petrine authorship	Authorship of the Petrine epistles
The Gospel of Mark was traditionally thought to show the influence of Peter 's preaching and eyewitness memories .	Gospel of Mark	Gospel of Mark

Several other books bearing his namethe Acts of Peter , Gospel of Peter , Preaching of Peter , Apocalypse of Peter , and Judgment of Peterare considered by Christian denominations as apocryphal , and are thus not included in their Bible canons .
